tldr: Evening batch (Sep 7) — AI governance widened beyond DC and Brussels today: UN Human Rights chief Volker Türk told the Human Rights Council that unchecked AI is an existential threat and 'a handful of men' hold 'almost unlimited power', naming Meta, OpenAI, Google and Anthropic directly and flagging plans to contact the labs outside normal government channels. On the buyer side, 'model fatigue' went mainstream after the Fable 5.1 → Muse Spark 1.3 → Gemini 3.8 Flash → Astra week: Gartner pegs 2026 AI spend at $2.59T (+47% YoY) while buyers struggle to absorb weekly flagship drops — evaluation is becoming a real cost. And Tencent open-sourced EVIE-8B, a visual document retriever that tops the ViDoRe V3 benchmark at 66.75 nDCG@10 — a candidate if you RAG over scanned PDFs or image-heavy docs.
